issues.title: [PULSE-225] Add confirmation page to bulk upload
issues.description:
Add a detailed confirmation page following a bulk upload. 

The detailed page should include all data entered for each action created. This will enable the user to quickly identify any issues following a bulk upload without having to open each action to review.
